newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb confident to achieve '98 goals.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb confident to achieve '98 goals.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb said Thrusday it is confident it will be able to achieve its goals for 1998 and beyond, although it remains "cautious" about the speed of recovery of the U.S. eyewear business.
The company also said it expects the strength of the U.S. dollar against international currency will continue to impact the company's reported results for the rest of 1997.
The company said it plans to step up its marketing efforts in the U.S. to deal with "disappointing" results in the eyeware segment.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.36 compared to $0.54 for the same period a year ago.
Excluding restructuring charges of $0.33 in the 1997 quarter and $0.19 in the 1996 quarter, the company's earnings per share for the quarter was $0.69 compared to $0.73.
Eyeware segment revenues were down 12 percent compared to last year, and were off 10 percent from the prior year on a constant dollar basis.
